notes.title: Meet the new tank!
notes.content:
Meet the new tank — MT-20 Hex! 
This unique battle tank from the near future combines high attack speed and lightning-fast movement. MT-20 Hex is ready to become your main striking force in the new year!
 Start the year with an advantage on the battlefield! The new tank will add freshness and drive to your game battles.
New Year's commanders are already in the game!
Klaus — a master of fortification and firepower, makes your tank a real fortress.
Winter — adds dynamics, increasing the speed of fire and movement.
Don't miss the chance! The tank and commanders are available for a limited time only. They will be the key to your victories and a nightmare for your enemies!

- The window with promotions has been updated, sections are grouped by type
- Optimization of tanks in combat
- Changed aiming when pointing at the enemy
- Added indication of hitting and destruction of the enemy
- Changed circling of enemy tanks
- Edits effects and lighting on maps
- Optimization and bug fixes

Hello Commander! The update is here!
What's new:
• New functionality "Crews"
• More consumable slots
• Fixed camera in combat
• Cruise control feature
• Graphics edits and optimization
Enjoy the game, there is much new stuff ahead!

notes.title: ⚠ FAQ about leagues ⚠
notes.content:
⚠ FAQ about leagues ⚠

❓Q: Where are my points for participating in the previous tournament system?
❗A: Your points for participating in the previous tournament system have not gone away. They will be transferred to a new league system.

❓Q: What is League promotion and what is the reward for?
❗A: Depending on the levels (experience), each of the Players was qualified for their own league. When qualifying, or when raising the league - the players are credited with rewards.

❓Q: Why did some teams receive "League Achievement Awards" and others not?
❗A: Clan members do not see the reward of their clan until the commander accepts the award. Distribution of awards between clan members, as before - is at the discretion of the commander.

❓Q: Why didn't all teams get rewards for the tournament?
❗A: We’ll clarify that there are no “awards for the tournament” yet.
"Rewards for tournaments", as before, will be awarded every week from Monday (during the day). Recent awards were for "Raising the League" (what is the "Award for raising the league" answered above)

❓Q: I am the commander of the clan, and I did not have a notice that I received an award for "Raising the League."
❗A: The clan commander should inform us in technical support via the hangar in the game or write to the mail: supxdevs@gmail.com

❓Q: Why don’t the Gold / Silver League results show in my area?
❗A: For the formation of correct results in the leagues, you need the necessary number of players. Perhaps, in your area/country there is no necessary number of players at the moment. As soon as the required number of Players reaches the Silver or Golden League, the results will be available.

❓Q: Why does not show the results of the Golden League?
❗A: Only High-Level Players play predominantly in the Golden League. For the formation of the results of this league need a little more time than in other leagues, because of the high-level players less than novices.

❓Q: From what level does the player enter the gold league?
❗A: The players of the Gold league are mostly of the highest levels. We cannot say exact figures since this system was introduced recently and may require balancing the values.

=================================================

⚠ Formation of leagues occurs dynamically. At the beginning of the update, not all Players and teams will visually display the results. During the week (as the activity of the players in your league), the results will be formed ⚠

❗ It is important to understand two nuances
1) There are many Bronze League players - their results will be generated faster than those of the Golden League Players.

2) Results for the world/countries will be formed faster than for the region.
For the same reason - the coverage of players around the world and countries more.

notes.title: Update! New tournament system! Leagues!
notes.content:
⚔ Good day, commanders! ⚔

We are pleased to announce the new update:

✅ Grandiose changes in the "tournament system"! 🏆
The new distribution of tournament places will be based on the experience of the Players and will be divided into three types:
1) Golden League 🥇
2) Silver League 🥈
3) Bronze League 🥉

Now each player will have more chances to win a prize in his league, and the total award fund will be distributed more equitably! 👍
Players who played «Metal Force» are already familiar with this system 😎

A little later, we will do a post about "FAQ related to the League", and also answer your questions in the comments!
